uncited: For wide-field-of-view cameras or spherical panoramas, this first-order affine approximation introduces significant artifacts, leading to [Spherical Panoramic Gaussian Splatting (SPaGS)](3042-spherical-panoramic-gaussian-splatting-spags.md) which uses exact ray-splat intersection with perpendicular planes to avoid covariance matrix inversion.

Concurrently, [Ray-Splat Intersection](6816-ray-splat-intersection.md) introduced BVH-based traversal for more complex scenes, supporting both spherical approximations and true ellipsoid intersections.

Numerical stability issues in quadratic solvers for quadric splats led to [Ray-splat Intersection with Numerical Stabilization](9972-ray-splat-intersection-with-numerical-stabilization.md), which switches to linear approximations when the quadratic coefficient is negligible. [Quadratic Gaussian Splatting](9978-quadratic-gaussian-splatting.md) further generalized this by using paraboloids and geodesic distances for surface reconstruction.
